title: Leaving Hampton and teaching school bands in Florida
summary: After finishing Hampton in May 1916 Brown played in Norfolk, then took a Florida job teaching school bands until the Army intervened.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: How long did you play there?

Not very long. Not very long. I'll tell you why. Because I finished Hampton in May of 16. Well, I went right to Norfolk and played in the Paris theater. And it wasn't very long before I got a letter from Hampton, offered me two school jobs. One in Topeka to teach school bands. That's really what I wanted to do. And one in Florida. So I selected one in Florida.
This was before the Florida job? Before.

Before. I went there and taught the school bands. That's what I wanted to do. And I suppose if I hadn't gotten in the Army, I probably would have made my home in Florida because there was one of the trustees, Mr. Balsall, Cullicolor, that owned a lot of property. I made one of them. Owned a couple of orange groves. And he said, Mr. Balsall, I made one of them myself, my honor. Land was very cheap. Land was very cheap. And he said, next year, you'll get yourself a part of land. I showed you how to go on. He had a couple of orange groves. But the next year, I was in the man's army. And I never went back to Florida. But I liked that. I liked that.
